features: Galaxy AI is here for your all-new Galaxy Buds3 Pro

Redefine your listening experience. Hear each note in crystal-clear clarity, with 24-bit CODEC. Minimise distortion with our first-ever, dual amp on Galaxy Buds. Capture a high range of intricate details with enhanced 2-way speaker — featuring a planar tweeter, a first on Galaxy Buds. Take your listening experience to the next level with Galaxy AI-boosted Noise Control and real-time interpretation. See your Buds in a new light.

Experience our all-new design engineered for optimal sound. Our re-imagined Galaxy Buds3 Pro feature small, angled heads for a comfortable fit and to streamline your audio experience while accented Blade Lights let you to express yourself. Highlighting the blade design is a sleek case with a transparent cover and delicate curved shape, equipped with USB-C and wireless charging capabilities.
Leave your phone in your pocket and conveniently control your earbuds by using simple gestures. Even with a swift swipe, rest assured your Galaxy Buds3 Pro stay securely in your ears.
Swipe Swipe up/down the Blade to adjust the volume.
Pinch Control Pinch to play and pause, or pinch and hold to launch your favorite app.

Immerse yourself in the elaborate details — from the deep rumble of the bass to the clear, crisp highs of the trebles — with enhanced 2-way speaker. Hear the vibrato of instruments with minimal distortion through our first-ever dual amp.

Powered by our first-ever, independently controlled woofer and tweeter, Galaxy Buds3 Pro diminishes interference between speakers — allowing you to experience a broader spectrum of sound and balance across various frequencies.

Discover an orchestra of sound — the full-bodied bass of the cello from the woofer to the subtle tremble of strings through a planar tweeter — coming together in harmony to evoke waves of emotion and unveil the minute details that would’ve gone unnoticed.

Retain ultra high quality audio from the recording studio to your Galaxy Buds3 Pro. The Samsung Seamless Codec compresses and encodes up to 24bit / 96kHz audio. Then, decodes on the Galaxy Buds3 Pro, maintaining the 24bit / 96kHz, high-fidelity sound so you can hear the intricate details, just as it was intended.
Galaxy AI adjusts sound to your fit

Delve into your personal soundscape with Galaxy AI-assisted Adaptive EQ/Adaptive ANC. Based on individual ear shape and wearing habits, our AI-boosted algorithm analyses sound detected through the inner and outer mics in real-time. Then, Galaxy AI optimizes your listening experience by adjusting the sound to conform to your fit with pinpoint precision.
Adaptive Noise Control. Tune into what matters

Keep your Galaxy Buds3 Pro on and continue to engage with the world around you. Using Galaxy AI, Galaxy Buds3 Pro identifies and prevents unnecessary noise intuitively. Then, it optimizes your audio experience by re-adjusting the balance between ANC and Ambient mode to correspond to your surroundings. So you can listen to your favorite tunes, uninterrupted.
Noise With Adaptive Noise Control, eliminate unwanted external noise – such as traffic, and enjoy the right mix of ANC and Ambient sound, allowing you to focus on hearing what you want to hear.
Conversation Carry on a conversation and Voice Detect will switch the ANC and Ambient sound on/off accordingly — so you can hear loud and clear without needing to take off your Galaxy Buds3 Pro.
Alarm/Siren Listen to your playlist in peace with Siren Detect. Galaxy Buds3 Pro blocks off unnecessary external noise, except for alarms and sirens, to warn you to steer clear of harm’s way.
Break language barriers at the blink of an AI

With Galaxy AI, understand the world like never before. See the translation on your Samsung Galaxy smartphone, and simultaneously hear your conversation interpreted in real-time through your Galaxy Buds3 Pro. Discover what it means to be truly free of language barriers.
Jump right in with TV 360 Audio

Dive into a spatial sound experience. 360 Audio is a feature that identifies the exact direction of the sound as you tilt your head, providing surround sound for a more vivid listening and viewing experience.
PC Auto Switch keeps the synergy going
PC Auto Switch on Galaxy Buds3 Pro detects audio activity and transfers the connection to your favorite Samsung Galaxy devices, so you can work and play seamlessly.
Share your sound with those around via Auracast

With Auracast broadcast technology, share your audio stream with an unlimited number of devices. Effortlessly transform your Samsung TV, Samsung Galaxy smartphone or tablet into a radio source to start engaging with others.
Convenient control with just a command
Control your audio settings without needing to touch your phone. Simply say a command, such as “next song” or “volume up” and let Galaxy Buds3 Pro do the rest.

Mindfulness comes with daily practice. At the press of a button, teleport to a worry-free world of your own with Samsung Health powered by Calm. Alleviate stress with peaceful melodies from nature, improve your focus with white noise or relax with ASMR-related for a happier, healthier you.

features: Curved for Your Comfort HUAWEI FreeArc is ergonomically crafted for a secure fit, as Huawei’s first open-ear earbuds with earhooks, with graceful curves and a breathable and comfortable listening experience.

C-bridge Design The earbuds’ C-bridge design is based on ergonomic analysis of over 10,000 auricle curves,4 and painstakingly optimised to ensure that it is as comfortable to wear as it is captivating to listen on.

Ultra-thin Shape-Memory Alloy HUAWEI FreeArc is made of a 0.7 mm high-performance Ni-Ti alloy, which offers tried-and-tested durability,5 and a seamlessly flexible form that adapts to various shapes of ears.

Skin-friendly Liquid Silicone The lightweight earbuds are 81.5% covered by soft liquid silicone4 and certified by SGS Smart Green Medal Certification, remaining comfortable to wear over the long haul.
140° Optimal Triangle Design The earbuds are engineered to stay fixed on your ears during workouts, thanks to a 140° optimal triangle support1 and gravity balance design.
Lightweight S-shaped Curves Gentle S-shaped curves mean less pressure on the tragus, larger contact area, and a snugger, more secure fit with the bud placed in the auricle.

Standout Water Resistance HUAWEI FreeArc is Huawei’s first pair of IP57 water resistant earbuds,2 and packs special water-resistant mics, which help keep rain and sweat at bay during running, cycling, yoga, and a lot more.
Sterling Sound Straight to Your Ears The innovative open-ear design keeps you aware of sounds in your surroundings, whether you’re working out, at work, or just walking about.

Punchy Bass, Richer Details Listen to your favourite songs as they’re meant to be heard, full of booming bass, soaring vocals, and high-frequency sounds with richer details, provided by a 17 × 12 mm highly-sensitive driver unit, symmetrical acoustic structure, dynamic bass algorithm, and adaptive equal-loudness algorithm.

Direct Sound Sound leakage is minimised by a sophisticated reverse sound waves system built inside the acoustic bean, meaning sounds are transmitted precisely into ear canal, making for a private listening⁠ experience6.
AI Crystal-clear Calls Stay heard even when calling from outdoors, with enhanced sound pickup and noise cancellation, made possible by a prime dual-mic layout and triple call noise cancellation.

Ultra-long-range Connection Listen to music and field calls phone-free with the powerful long-range connections made possible by Huawei’s innovative dual-resonator antenna. Stay connected around a 400 m runway4 or in a 100 m² office.

Charge Faster, Listen Longer Listen to music for up to 28 hours with a fully charged charging case, or up to 7 hours3 with just the earbuds alone. You can even enjoy 3 hours of listening on a quick 10-minute charge.
Dual-device Connection Connect the HUAWEI FreeArc to two devices such as phones, tablets, PCs, or watches, and seamlessly switch audio between them, whether the device runs iOS, Android, or Windows.

The Black Shark T23 Earbuds have a frequency range of 20Hz to 20KHz with a sensitivity of 108±3dB. They provide a balanced and dynamic audio performance with deep, resonant bass and crystal-clear highs, bringing every track to life.
Powered by modern Bluetooth 5.4 technology, they provide a steady and fast connection across your devices, whether you’re streaming music, making calls, or gaming on the go.

These Black Shark Earbuds have precision-engineered 13mm dynamic drivers that recreate every element of sound with remarkable clarity, while smart ENC technology reduces background noise during calls for improved communication.
Smart touch controls make it simple to navigate playlists and settings, allowing you to adjust your audio experience intuitively.

features: Galaxy AI is here for your all-new Galaxy Buds3 Pro

Redefine your listening experience. Hear each note in crystal-clear clarity, with 24-bit CODEC. Minimise distortion with our first-ever, dual amp on Galaxy Buds. Capture a high range of intricate details with enhanced 2-way speaker — featuring a planar tweeter, a first on Galaxy Buds. Take your listening experience to the next level with Galaxy AI-boosted Noise Control and real-time interpretation. See your Buds in a new light.

Experience our all-new design engineered for optimal sound. Our re-imagined Galaxy Buds3 Pro feature small, angled heads for a comfortable fit and to streamline your audio experience while accented Blade Lights let you to express yourself. Highlighting the blade design is a sleek case with a transparent cover and delicate curved shape, equipped with USB-C and wireless charging capabilities.
Leave your phone in your pocket and conveniently control your earbuds by using simple gestures. Even with a swift swipe, rest assured your Galaxy Buds3 Pro stay securely in your ears.
Swipe Swipe up/down the Blade to adjust the volume.
Pinch Control Pinch to play and pause, or pinch and hold to launch your favorite app.

Immerse yourself in the elaborate details — from the deep rumble of the bass to the clear, crisp highs of the trebles — with enhanced 2-way speaker. Hear the vibrato of instruments with minimal distortion through our first-ever dual amp.

Powered by our first-ever, independently controlled woofer and tweeter, Galaxy Buds3 Pro diminishes interference between speakers — allowing you to experience a broader spectrum of sound and balance across various frequencies.

Discover an orchestra of sound — the full-bodied bass of the cello from the woofer to the subtle tremble of strings through a planar tweeter — coming together in harmony to evoke waves of emotion and unveil the minute details that would’ve gone unnoticed.

Retain ultra high quality audio from the recording studio to your Galaxy Buds3 Pro. The Samsung Seamless Codec compresses and encodes up to 24bit / 96kHz audio. Then, decodes on the Galaxy Buds3 Pro, maintaining the 24bit / 96kHz, high-fidelity sound so you can hear the intricate details, just as it was intended.
Galaxy AI adjusts sound to your fit

Delve into your personal soundscape with Galaxy AI-assisted Adaptive EQ/Adaptive ANC. Based on individual ear shape and wearing habits, our AI-boosted algorithm analyses sound detected through the inner and outer mics in real-time. Then, Galaxy AI optimizes your listening experience by adjusting the sound to conform to your fit with pinpoint precision.
Adaptive Noise Control. Tune into what matters

Keep your Galaxy Buds3 Pro on and continue to engage with the world around you. Using Galaxy AI, Galaxy Buds3 Pro identifies and prevents unnecessary noise intuitively. Then, it optimizes your audio experience by re-adjusting the balance between ANC and Ambient mode to correspond to your surroundings. So you can listen to your favorite tunes, uninterrupted.
Noise With Adaptive Noise Control, eliminate unwanted external noise – such as traffic, and enjoy the right mix of ANC and Ambient sound, allowing you to focus on hearing what you want to hear.
Conversation Carry on a conversation and Voice Detect will switch the ANC and Ambient sound on/off accordingly — so you can hear loud and clear without needing to take off your Galaxy Buds3 Pro.
Alarm/Siren Listen to your playlist in peace with Siren Detect. Galaxy Buds3 Pro blocks off unnecessary external noise, except for alarms and sirens, to warn you to steer clear of harm’s way.
Break language barriers at the blink of an AI

With Galaxy AI, understand the world like never before. See the translation on your Samsung Galaxy smartphone, and simultaneously hear your conversation interpreted in real-time through your Galaxy Buds3 Pro. Discover what it means to be truly free of language barriers.
Jump right in with TV 360 Audio

Dive into a spatial sound experience. 360 Audio is a feature that identifies the exact direction of the sound as you tilt your head, providing surround sound for a more vivid listening and viewing experience.
PC Auto Switch keeps the synergy going
PC Auto Switch on Galaxy Buds3 Pro detects audio activity and transfers the connection to your favorite Samsung Galaxy devices, so you can work and play seamlessly.
Share your sound with those around via Auracast

With Auracast broadcast technology, share your audio stream with an unlimited number of devices. Effortlessly transform your Samsung TV, Samsung Galaxy smartphone or tablet into a radio source to start engaging with others.
Convenient control with just a command
Control your audio settings without needing to touch your phone. Simply say a command, such as “next song” or “volume up” and let Galaxy Buds3 Pro do the rest.

Mindfulness comes with daily practice. At the press of a button, teleport to a worry-free world of your own with Samsung Health powered by Calm. Alleviate stress with peaceful melodies from nature, improve your focus with white noise or relax with ASMR-related for a happier, healthier you.

Intelligent noise control The best thing you’ve never heard.

Introducing the world’s best in-ear Active Noise Cancellation for the most immersive listening experience ever.13 Designed with an upgraded acoustic seal, AirPods Pro 3 automatically adapt to your environment and preferences. And new ultra-low-noise microphones remove even more unwanted sound. So you only hear what you want — in an unheard-of audio experience.
Removes up to 2x more unwanted noise than AirPods Pro 2
Removes up to 4x more unwanted noise than original AirPods Pro

New ultra-low-noise microphones. Using advanced computational audio to remove more noise around you than ever, AirPods Pro 3 let you zone in (or out) when you need to. And five all-new ear tips — including an XXS option — fuse a thin layer of soft foam to the silicone shell to give you even better acoustic performance.

Voice Isolation. AirPods Pro 3 reduce background noise and isolate voices during calls. So whether you’re on the bus or in a café, every conversation is loud and clear. AirPods Pro 3, white color, noise-cancelling microphone, silicone tip, short stem

Adaptive Audio. AirPods Pro 3 combine Active Noise Cancellation with next-level Transparency, which makes your voice and the world around you sound even more natural and vibrant, intelligently adapting to your environment to prioritize what you need to hear, when you need to hear it.

A person wearing AirPods Pro 3 staring into their iPhone Conversation Awareness. AirPods Pro 3 can detect when you’re talking to someone nearby and automatically lower the volume of whatever you’re listening to. When you’re done, the volume goes right back to where you had it.

Powered by the Apple-designed H2 chip, AirPods Pro 3 feature a completely redesigned acoustic architecture that brings breathtaking, all-around-you audio to everything you listen to — from your pump-up playlist to your weekly FaceTime call with family.

A new multiport acoustic architecture with more precise airflow control — featuring an inward-facing microphone that points directly into the ear canal — delivers deeper bass, vivid vocal clarity, and a wider soundstage, so you never miss a note.
A custom-built driver and amplifier work with the H2 chip to create high-definition, three-dimensional sound, with superlow distortion during playback.

AirPods Pro 3 feature next-generation Adaptive EQ, which customizes a sound signature for your unique ear geometry and fit. And Personalized Volume uses machine learning to understand your listening patterns and adapt to your preferences over time.

Adaptive EQ tunes music to your ears in real time based on the fit of your AirPods. Inward-facing microphones measure what you’re hearing, then adjust the low to high frequencies of a song — so you get consistently detailed playback, every time.
Personalized Spatial Audio uses the TrueDepth camera on your iPhone to create a custom profile based on the geometry of your head, delivering deeply immersive sound tailored to you.
Dynamic head tracking makes conversations feel like they’re happening in the same room — whether you’re gaming with friends or hosting a Group FaceTime call with family.

All-new heart rate sensing helps you track your heart rate and calories burned during workouts. Using LEDs that pulse invisible light 256 times per second — and sensor fusion from the accelerometers — AirPods Pro 3 give you incredibly accurate data for up to 50 different workout types in the Fitness app. And with a more secure in-ear fit, you can go all out and they won’t come out.

Fitness app. With just AirPods Pro 3 and iPhone, you can dive into the new workout experience in the Fitness app, which includes things like walking, cycling, and HIIT. You can set your favorite music and podcasts to play automatically when you start a workout. With the new Apple Intelligence–enabled Workout Buddy feature, you can get personalized messages that keep you going.20 And with access to your Move ring — and even the Burn Bar in Fitness+ — you might just never stop.

IP57 dust, sweat, and water resistance. A first for AirPods, an IP57 rating means AirPods Pro 3 are more durable than ever.10 Thanks to precision engineering combined with robust testing, you can feel confident during even the sweatiest workouts.
Check, aid, and help protect your hearing.

AirPods Pro 3 bring improvements to the world’s first end-to-end hearing health experience.6 Now you can take a scientifically validated Hearing Test in a broader range of background conditions. The Hearing Aid feature adds improved voice clarity, automatic Conversation Boost,7 and 67 percent more battery life in Transparency on a single charge.8 And active Hearing Protection helps prevent exposure to loud environmental noise.

Battery life. Hearing Aid users now get 67 percent more battery life in Transparency on a single charge. That’s a total of up to 10 hours, making it easier than ever to use this breakthrough capability morning, noon, and night.

Automatic Conversation Boost. Now when you’re having a conversation in a busy restaurant or office, Conversation Boost will automatically amplify the voice of the person you’re talking to while minimizing the distracting noises around you. And with the new microphones, transducer, and amplifier, your voice will sound clearer and more natural than ever.

Hearing Test and Hearing Aid. With a better fit and increased noise cancellation, you can now take a scientifically validated Hearing Test in a broader range of everyday background conditions — from the comfort of your home. And if you have mild to moderate hearing loss, you can use the improved Hearing Aid feature wherever you go.

Hearing Protection. In addition to passive noise reduction from the ear tips, active Hearing Protection helps prevent exposure to loud environmental noise. Machine learning on the H2 chip reduces noise 48,000 times per second while maintaining natural and vibrant sound for whatever you’re listening to.

AirPods Pro 3 are packed with features that make even the simplest moments seem extraordinary. From the all-new Live Translation feature5 to superconvenient camera control,11 there’s so much more to AirPods than meets the ear.

With Live Translation, powered by Apple Intelligence, you can listen to people speaking in different languages and hear translations through your AirPods Pro 3. To respond, just speak naturally, and your words will appear in the other person’s language on your iPhone screen. To make the experience even more magical, if you both have AirPods Pro 3, you can each speak in your own language and hear translations through your AirPods.

The MagSafe Charging Case is full of helpful features — like a built-in speaker and more powerful Precision Finding — that let you keep track of your AirPods Pro 3 no matter where they are.26 And now just a single charge will take you all the way through the workday. Plus overtime.

features: Three Voice Tone Presets, Two-Level Noise Cancelling
Automatic Limiting to Prevent Audio Clipping
DJI Mic Mini 2 Mini Wireless Microphone

JI Mic Mini 2 is a compact wireless mic with multi-color magnetic covers to match most outfits. Three voice tone presets, mixed device connection and DJI OsmoAudio deliver high-quality audio. Long battery life and all-in-one storage let you create with ease.
The standard Obsidian Black and Glaze White magnetic front covers of the transmitter feature a refined design that blends aesthetics and practicality, fitting seamlessly into different scenarios.
Whether you’re capturing city adventures or enjoying outdoor sports, eight vibrant multi-color magnetic front covers turn ordinary moments into extraordinary creative experiences.

The DJI Mic Mini 2 Transmitter weighs about 11 g, making it comfortable to wear. The detachable, rotatable magnetic clip allows you to flexibly adjust the microphone angle, whether clipped sideways or inverted, ensuring optimal audio capture in any scenario.

The upgraded charging case and the new mobile charging case can neatly hold the transmitter, receiver, and accessories, keeping everything organized and ready to go. The mobile version is specifically tailored to meet diverse mobile recording needs.
Life Unbound, in Color and Sound

DJI has collaborated with internationally renowned illustrator Victo Ngai to create the DJI Mic Mini 2 Time Series Magnetic Front Cover. The four illustrations delicately capture different stages of life, inspiring unique creativity at every step of your audio journey.
Family Moments Capture every laugh and babble with clarity, no complex setup required. Record the most natural, uninhibited sounds of growing up.
Live Events Accurately reproduce the delicate vibrations and rich tones of instruments, recreating an immersive, on-site listening experience.
City Walks From the hustle of city traffic to the chirp of mountain birds, high-fidelity audio lets you hear the world breathe. Bring back travel memories you can truly listen to.
Outdoor Cycling Keep conversations clear even as you cut through the wind. Record the dialogue of speed and passion on every ride.
Small in Size, Big in Brilliance

Three Voice Tone Presets To Match Your Style The default Regular mode delivers a clean, natural, and balanced audio; Rich mode puts extra emphasis on the lows for a fuller, more powerful sound; while Bright mode highlights the highs, giving your voice extra clarity and sparkle.
Basic: Pure Indoor Sound The Basic noise cancelling level is ideal for quiet indoor settings, reducing fan, air conditioning, and reverb noises while preserving vocal clarity.
Strong: Clear Amidst Noise The Strong noise cancelling level excels in noisy environments, significantly cutting ambient noise for clearer vocals.

Automatic Limiting to Prevent Audio Clipping When automatic limiting is enabled, DJI Mic Mini 2 automatically lowers the volume if the audio input is too high, preventing clipping and ensuring reliable audio quality. This is especially useful for content creators.

Safety Track, Extra Assurance By enabling safety track in the DJI Mimo app, DJI Mic Mini 2 can record in dual tracks. The main track records at normal volume, while the second track records at 6 dB lower, helping prevent issues like clipping or distortion especially during live events.

Five-Level Gain Adjustment The gain can be quickly adjusted in five levels using the dial on the receiver, making operation convenient and efficient. Proper gain adjustment can effectively enhance audio clarity.

Multi-Color Windscreens With the windscreen attached, the transmitter effectively reduces wind noise and other unwanted noise, delivering crisp, clear audio even in windy conditions or noisy environments—ideal for live streaming, vlogging, and more.
Compatible With Multiple Devices DJI Mic Mini 2 uses the DJI Mic Mini Receiver and can be easily paired with cameras, smartphones, computers, and tablets. More capable, more versatile.

DJI OsmoAudio Direct Connection Osmo Pocket 4, Osmo 360, Osmo Nano, Osmo Action 6, and other devices can connect directly with up to two DJI Mic Mini 2 Transmitters via DJI OsmoAudio without an additional receiver, easily delivering 48kHz 24-bit studio-quality audio.
The DJI Mic Mini Receiver supports mixed connections with the DJI Mic Mini/DJI Mic Mini 2 Transmitters for effortless multi-source recording.

In green light mode, the mobile receiver pairs with any two transmitters from DJI Mic Mini or Mic Mini 2. In blue light mode, it pairs with any two transmitters from DJI Mic Mini, Mic Mini 2, Mic 2, or Mic 3.
The Noise Cancellation Mode Switch on the mobile receiver lets you quickly switch between Strong and Basic noise-cancelling modes.
Once the receiver or transmitter is connected to your phone, you can use the DJI Mimo app to adjust its settings and upgrade its firmware.

Long Range, Stable Transmission When used with the DJI Mic Mini Receiver in DJI Mic Mini 2 (2 TX + 1 RX), transmission distance can reach up to 400 meters. Even when paired with the mobile receiver, you’ll still enjoy stable transmission up to 300 meters.

48-Hour Operating Time & Power Saving The transmitter and receiver deliver up to 11.5 and 10.5 hours of operating time, respectively. The fully charged charging case extends this to 48 hours. Whether for long interviews or livestreams, enjoy seamless creativity and uninterrupted inspiration.

JBL Signature Sound with Hi-Res Audio (wired and wireless)

JBL Signature Sound delivers greater clarity, detail, and range, bringing your music to life with the richness and precision of true Hi-Res audio. JBL Spatial Sound immerses you in 3D sound from any stereo content. Finetune your sound experience with the JBL Headphones app whether you’re in wireless or wired mode.
True Adaptive Noise Cancelling 2.0, real time calibration

The six microphones advanced technology of the JBL Live 780NC headphones allows to precisely capture and filter environmental noises. The microphones continuously analyze your surroundings, adjusting in real time to block distractions with greater accuracy. Or you can use the JBL Headphones App to adjust how much of the outside world to let in. Stay focused on your music, your work, or your peace of mind—wherever you are.
Dual beamforming mics and intelligent noise cancellation cut through traffic, wind, and background hum. Every word comes through naturally clear, just like you’re both in the same room.

Connect with lower power, at higher quality and not only via Bluetooth. Stream your own content or tap into AuracastTM for audio sharing right from the JBL Headphones app. It’s future-ready listening made simple. broadcasts right from the JBL Headphones app. It’s future-ready listening made simple.

With up to 80 hours* of battery life, your music goes further than ever. And when you’re running low, just a 5-minute speed charge gives you 4 more hours of playtime, so you’re never without your soundtrack. (*With ANC off. Up to 50 hours with ANC on.)
Pair with two Bluetooth devices at once and switch without missing a beat. Watch a movie on your tablet in the airport lounge, then pick up your phone instantly when it rings, interruption-free.
Fully foldable comfort that moves with you

Soft, ergonomically shaped earcups and a lightweight silicone headband keep you listening for hours without pressure. The over-ear design enhances both comfort and acoustic performance, while a sturdy metal hinge adds durability. And when you’re done listening, they fold flat in a heartbeat and slip into their soft pouch, ready to go anywhere.
Customizable through the JBL Headphones app

Use the JBL Headphones App to tailor make your sound settings, activate Spatial Sound, personalize your sound with Personi-fi 3.0, customize the touch and button control features, personalize the call settings and much more. The Low Volume Dynamic EQ provides powerful sound even when listening at a lower volume. Turn on the Personal Sound Amplification feature to adjust the left and right earcups’ balance and amplify the conversations volume.

Hear and feel every note of your playlist. Shape your audio to match your personal listening profile with interactive customization tools that use precise information about you and your preferences to provide the exact sound curve that suits you best.
Seamless control with JBL Smart Tx

Plug into any 3.5 mm or USB-C source and still enjoy wireless freedom—no Bluetooth needed. Smart Tx keeps your favorite features at your fingertips, so you can connect anywhere without compromise. The JBL Smart TX can be purchased separately

Health Monitoring It excels in health monitoring with a heart rate monitor that delivers real-time statistics on your cardiovascular health, and a steps tracker that keeps you informed about your daily activity levels, promoting a healthier lifestyle.

Water Resistance and Durability This Black Shark GS3 smartwatch is meant to be life waterproof, which means it can withstand splashes, rain, and ordinary water exposure, but it is not ideal for swimming or diving.

Customization and GPS The Black Shark GS3 lacks a SIM card slot, a mechanical mechanism, and a back camera, instead focusing on essential functionality and a compact look. With different dials available, you may easily customize the Black Shark GS3 watch face to meet your style or tastes. The addition of GPS capabilities increases its value by enabling precise position tracking and navigation, making it an excellent companion for outdoor activities.

Battery and Operating System The Black Shark GS3 smartwatch does not operate in network mode, therefore it relies on Bluetooth for communication. It is powered by a powerful battery with a capacity ranging from 300 to 450mAh, allowing you to get through the day without needing to recharge frequently. The GS3 runs the Android Wear operating system and is compatible with a wide range of devices, delivering a seamless and integrated user experience.

Memory and Language Support The device has less than 128MB of RAM and ROM, which is adequate for smooth operation and important data storage. It supports the English language and provides useful features like a pedometer that precisely counts your steps.

Stylish and Functional Designed to be worn on the wrist, the Black Shark GS3 combines sophisticated features, sturdy performance, and an attractive appearance, making it an excellent choice for anybody wishing to improve their everyday life with cutting-edge wearable technology.

Battle -50℃ extreme cold, outlast 70℃ blazing heat, endure humidity, shock, and more — KOSPET TANK M4 is a tactical smartwatch, tested by SGS, an independent European lab, against 20 U.S. MIL-STD-810H standards, ready for your most rugged adventures. An integrated ambient light sensor ensures its 1.96-inch AMOLED display remains clear from dawn to dusk.
Inox Shield Structure from Top to Bottom

From the bezel and the case to physical buttons, KOSPET TANK M4 is sculpted with an Inox 360 shield structure featuring full stainless steel construction, striking the perfect balance between exceptional strength and timeless design.

Tested and proven by SGS, the Europe’s leading independent lab, KOSPET TANK M4 demonstrates its superior resilience and toughness by passing up to 20 U.S. MIL-STD-810H tests. The rugged smartwatch thrives with you, however dusty, muddy, or rainy the adventure gets.

With 10 ATM and IP69K water resistance ratings, KOSPET TANK M4 is not just a rugged smartwatch but also a reliable scuba diving watch alternative. It is built to endure 100-meter water pressure and support dives up to 45 meters—making every swim, surf, or dive worry-free.
Water Resistance Tested by SGS, Europe’s leading independent lab.

Built to endure 10 ATM and IP69K conditions, the KOSPET TANK M4 functions as a versatile waterproof smartwatch, offering three dedicated dive modes to enrich your underwater experiences. Explore a wide array of diving metrics, including depth, dive time, ascent and descent rates, and more.

Besides tracking surface intervals crucial for diving safety, KOSPET TANK M4 monitors each freediving session with data like dive time, maximum depth, and average temperature, complemented by its built-in breath-holding training and tests for improved stamina.

Thanks to support for 23 ApexMotion sports modes and 160 freestyle training modes, KOSPET TANK M4 stands out among cool outdoor watches, serving to track your every movement and every effort through a broad range of specialized data — from real-time running metrics and elevation gain to pool laps and gym workouts.
From real-time pace and cadence during track running to VO2 max and recovery time in trail running, KOSPET TANK M4 assists you to measure your every move, every effort, and every improvement.

With its advanced 6-axis gyroscope, KOSPET TANK M4 keeps up with your intense workouts and swift directional changes. It accurately captures shifts in motion, posture, and momentum — delivering more precise data, smarter activity analysis, and deeper insights into how your body performs when it matters most.
Stay Way Ahead of the Curve

KOSPET TANK M4 is designed for elite runners and those who aspire to push their limits. With support from precision dual-band (L1+L5) and six satellite positioning systems, the smartwatch tracks every lap in track running and every route during trail running with exceptional precision.

To give a strong boost in positioning and keep pace with your performance, KOSPET TANK M4 leverages the brand new OPDR algorithm that tracks your real-time activity status despite weak or unavailable GPS signals — under bridges, among high-rise buildings, and other challenging conditions.
32GB Storage, More Space for What Matters

KOSPET TANK M4 is a smartwatch with 32 storage capacity for impressive music and offline map storage. It holds about 100 offline maps or 5,000 songs, giving you both navigation and entertainment without relying on your phone—perfect for staying informed and inspired on the go.
Chart and navigate your own path with KOSPET TANK M4 — import GPX or KML route files via the Apexmove App or download offline maps online using your computer or tablet.

Whether you are cycling through the woods or hiking along a trail with your friends, use the built-in Walkie-talkie on KOSPET TANK M4 to instantly communicate with each other via a simple touch-and-hold.
Shed More Light on Your Health

Powered by the cutting-edge 4PD health sensor that captures richer optical signals for improved measurement precision, KOSPET TANK M4 elevates daily health monitoring to a whole new level, even during high-intensity workouts.

Heart Rate Monitoring Stay informed about your heart health with all-day heart rate monitoring and abnormal heart rate alerts, all supported on the KOSPET TANK M4, a rugged waterproof heart rate monitor watch built for both daily use and outdoor adventures.
Blood Oxygen Monitoring KOSPET TANK M4 measures your SpO2 throughout the day with low blood oxygen alerts to keep an eye on the condition of your respiratory system.
Sleep Tracking Create a sleep schedule that suits you and wake up to your sleep progress and total time spent in main sleep stages (including REM) on KOSPET TANK M4.
Menstrual Cycle Tracking KOSPET TANK M4 tracks your menstrual cycle for better health with predictions and reminders for your upcoming period, fertile window, and ovulation day.
One-Tap Health Check Easily monitor your heart rate, blood oxygen, stress level, and mood with a single tap on KOSPET TANK M4 for a comprehensive overview of your health status.
Keep Pace with You for Longer

With up to 15 days of typical use, KOSPET TANK M4 is a smartwatch with long battery life meticulously built to perform in peak condition, so you never have to worry about power between charges while moving, training, or exploring.

Lightweight, compact, and easy-to-store, our new power pocket can deliver more than one full charge for KOSPET TANK M4. Featuring a magnetic connector, the power pocket allows for simultaneous charging with the smartwatch.

Brings Out Your Best Ideas HUAWEI M-Pencil (2ⁿᵈ generation) is instantly responsive to every stroke on screen, allowing you sketch and scribble to your heart’s content. 4096-level pressure sensing allows it to perceive the slightest change in force, and create lines of varying thickness.
